_doc: Hit size of every straight projectile (knives, darts, venom, Gulp's tongue, Mountain Maw's head, Cast Line's rod; not lobs, whose burst is their own). radius_mult scales each projectile's "radius" and "radius_end" from data/creatures/<id>.json. A projectile with "radius_end" grows from radius to radius_end over its flight, so a hook is widest at the end of its reach. Hit size only: what's drawn doesn't change.
